purpose: Pilot movement evidence and field-review queue. These are scoped observations, not whole-route approvals or a replacement for the source snapshot.
default_profile: ordinary passenger car on a through trip
method: Review official project descriptions and the local OSM snapshot; manual Street View links are navigation aids only. A plan, project-level completion label, or older image does not establish the present movement.

direction_notes.forward: Wood from Augusta to Cortez is southbound-only for motor vehicles in the OSM snapshot. The 1st Ward's CDOT project update specifies this conversion and two-way bicycle access. This is a motor-direction restriction; current physical treatment and installation date are not independently verified.
